Dr. Daniel Pompa told Kevin Trudeau where ordinary aluminum exposure actually comes from: it's part of the chemical mix added to jet fuel.

His point: acid rain carries that aluminum back down, and it ends up in our food and water supply.

Then there's the everyday mistake most of us make without thinking: wrapping hot, fatty food in aluminum foil, which lets it leach straight into the meal.

His advice: keep foil off your food entirely.
